Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style College Boy Mike Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6288]College Boy Mike - Custom NPC[/url] mod Character Mike, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. 

Including Airyn's DSV Mike portrait. ([b]Only includes the portrait[/b], if you want Airyn's DSV Mike sprite, please go download Airyn's DSV Mike in the Miscellaneous files: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6288?tab=files]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6288?tab=files[/url].)

*Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Mike mod (some where in Stardew Valley\Mods folder)
Drag the "MIKE" folder from my Zip into the Stardew Valley\Mods folder to overwrite the "MIKE" folder in it.

This mod replaces the default portrait of Mike.
If the portraits is not showing, please make sure the folder overwrites the correct files.



Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

And [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] version. For people who prefer to install them with Portraiture.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6288]College Boy Mike - Custom NPC[/url] mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6288]College Boy Mike - Custom NPC[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76422008]Brimini[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
DSV Mike's design belong to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
